facts: Connect USB tool and run SST USB stress 12 hours on rear slots 1-2.
Criteria require clean SST/SEL; machine time is only 48 minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO due to physical environment/USB setup.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with dual-port mapping and condensation controls.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify both DC-SCM rear USB 2.0 ports remain functional for 12-hour USB stress at 0 C/-5% rails.
must_preserve: Both named ports, USB 2.0 path, 12 hours, cold/undervoltage environment.
unknowns: Tool/device workload, concurrent/sequential coverage, error counters and severe 48-minute metadata conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It does not highlight the 48-minute conflict or require proof that both physical ports carried traffic for the full intended interval.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep manual cold/rail/connection handling; resolve duration and require port-specific topology and traffic evidence.

revision_candidate.test_name: Stress DC-SCM Rear USB 2.0 Ports 1-2 at 0 C and -5% Rails
revision_candidate.purpose: Exercise both named rear USB 2.0 ports for the approved 12-hour coverage and verify no disconnect, protocol/data, power or platform error under cold undervoltage.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact DC-SCM revision, supported USB stress devices, calibrated 0 C chamber and -5% rails with condensation controls.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Physical rear ports 1 and 2 mapped to USB bus/port paths and device serials; no front/internal port substitution.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Port map, approved tools/workload and data-integrity rule, concurrent/sequential duration allocation, 12-hour/48-minute correction, USB power limits and recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator installs verified tools and establishes environment; supervised workload records per-port enumeration, throughput/integrity and disconnect/reset counters throughout the signed duration.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Both ports enumerate at nominal baseline, moisture controls/OOB recovery are active.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Photos and physical-to-bus mapping; device serials; exact SST parameters; per-port traffic/integrity and kernel USB reset/disconnect data for the full interval; chamber/rail/SEL/power trace; warm-up/restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Both ports complete required coverage with zero disallowed SST, USB, power or BMC error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No condensation exposure, unapproved bus-powered load, port substitution, log clearing or 48-minute substitute.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Operator controls environment/connections; platform owner approves tools and timing.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical USB/environment tasks are manual; workload evidence may be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop traffic, remove tools safely, warm/restore nominal conditions and verify both ports/DC-SCM/BMC.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Moisture, port/device loss, USB reset/error, power fault, fixture drift, host/BMC failure or missing per-port evidence.

reason_for_change: Two physical rear ports require independent bus-path proof; a single USB tool log and a 48-minute schedule cannot establish the named 12-hour dual-port activity.
removed_ambiguities: Rear ports cannot be replaced by another USB path.
remaining_blockers: Timing and workload need owner correction.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 exposes the largest duration inconsistency in this margin subset and binds evidence to each exact DC-SCM rear port rather than an undifferentiated USB result.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 53 names DC-SCM rear USB2.0 ports 1-2 and 12-hour SST, yet machine time is 48 minutes.
